-- test: logfile basic --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logfile
-- expect:stdout --
INFO
-- expect:stdout --
TestActuatorApplication


-- test: logfile tail bytes --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logfile --tail-bytes 500
-- expect:regex --
INFO|WARN|ERROR


-- test: logfile invalid tail bytes --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logfile --tail-bytes -5
-- expect:error --
cannot be negative
-- expect:stderr --
cannot be negative


-- test: logfile to file --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logfile --output-file /tmp/kubectl-actuator-test.log
-- expect:stderr --
Wrote
-- expect:stderr --
/tmp/kubectl-actuator-test.log


-- test: heapdump to file --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} heapdump --output-file /tmp/kubectl-actuator-test.hprof
-- expect --
Requesting heap dump
-- expect --
Wrote


-- test: heapdump live to file --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} heapdump --live --output-file /tmp/kubectl-actuator-test.hprof
-- expect --
Wrote


-- test: heapdump streams to stdout --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} heapdump --output-file -
-- expect:stdout --
JAVA PROFILE
-- expect:stderr --
Requesting heap dump
-- expect:stderr --
Wrote
